headline: French Bakeries Adjust Operations Amid High Energy and Raw Material Inflation
summary: French bakeries face rising raw material and energy costs alongside constrained consumer purchasing power, attempting to limit baguette price increases while marking up secondary goods.
why: France's retail food sector reflects broader European food price inflation and small-business operating margin pressures.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: Input cost inflation pressures retail profit margins across small food businesses.
